ImageDescription.value:
I was surprised to find the New Brunswick Railway Museum, it is located in Hillsborough, that preserves the history of the Canadian Railroad. Because I was here so early (about 4:30am) the place was closed but I will have to visit it again when opened.
The collection about 27 pieces of rolling stock, including passenger cars, freight cars and maintenance-of-way equipment. Steam engines and other equipment were in large sheds and they were not open one I was there.
